title: Verdict on the 34 bubble-free pilot cards
ask: Score each card on the pilot page (situation, neighbour test, stray act). A pass releases the other ~133 bubble cards and the 69 new phrase cards for drawing.

title: A new scene for koks (what kind of)
ask: It keeps reading as kuris (which) after two redraws. The current scene is a customer hesitating over three cups of different shapes. Suggest a scene, or let Fable propose three.

title: Small inset panels on single-scene cards
ask: Most single-scene pilot cards still carry small inset panels, because the house-style opening sentence describes insets. Keep them, or make single scenes truly single?

title: Look over the 43 new pictures and 5 redraws
ask: New A2 words from the English benchmark, plus vandenynas, sala and the three flag cards redrawn. All pass the automatic check.
options: Some need redraws (marked on the page)

title: Section names in the top band
ask: Cards are grouped into 20 sections (I–XX), e.g. "Section VI · food", "Section XIX · phrases". Rename or regroup any?

title: English caption on fill-in-the-blank cards
ask: Picture cards show the English in the bottom band. Should fill-in-the-blank (cloze) fronts show it too? Showing it gives the meaning away along with the sentence; hiding it keeps the sentence as the only cue.

title: Typeface
ask: PT Serif can't draw the tilde and grave stress marks (as in ė̃); those letters fall back to Old Standard TT and look slightly different. Keep PT Serif, or switch to a typeface that covers every mark?

title: Plate numbers for A2
ask: Should A2 continue the count (1001 onward) or restart as "A2 · 0001"? Right now the deck uses three numbering systems.

title: Formal/informal lines on phrase backs
ask: Add the tu/jūs variant and register lines to phrase backs now, or after you've recorded the audio?

title: Picture on the back
ask: Repeat the full picture on the back (as now), or a small thumbnail so the word sits near the top?

title: Approve the back redesign
ask: Word large at the top, then stress, audio, gender and forms (the taught form in bold), then a smaller meaning line, then the picture.

title: Faces or surroundings
ask: Heads in our pictures are 40–80 px of flat paint, so a likeness of Darius won't read as Darius. Recommended: suggest figures through their world (the orange Lituanica, Žemaitė's headscarf and pen, the real buildings). Or try named faces.

title: President card
ask: Adamkus is a living person in a public deck, and wouldn't have been president in 1981. Options: an unnamed interwar statesman before the Seimas building (recommended), Grinius, or Adamkus.

title: Approve the ~$0.14 test
ask: Six test pictures: the Lituanica, Žemaitė, the Sports Hall, the Palace of Justice, and one try each at Adamkus and Grinius by name.

title: Four corrections to existing cards
ask: Hospital → the 1939 Kaunas Clinics; the Soviet-era Maironis statue → the 1928 Freedom Statue; the Vytis removed from the Seimas card (flag-only rule); the tram removed from A2-0722 (Lithuania had no trams in 1981).

title: Which of the 26 new real places to adopt
ask: Mostly interwar Kaunas: Palace of Justice, Central Post Office, Bank of Lithuania, War Museum, Sports Hall, State Stadium, Town Hall square, Vilnius Philharmonic, Romuva, Konrado kavinė and more.

title: Delete the old deck and import v2.1
ask: Lietuviu_Flashcards_v2.1_A1.apkg and …_A2.apkg are in the project folder on your Mac.

title: Record the audio
ask: Use recorder_A2.html in a2_build on your Mac; include a re-record of 265 lūpos.
